ul.li: Guard Users: Set to "Portal" (guards access mobile portal)
All Other Users: Set to "Internal User" (Client User, Supervisor, Manager, Administrator)

ol.li:
Guard Pro Group: Assign the appropriate group:
Guard User: Portal user for guards (mobile portal access only)
Client User: Internal user for clients viewing their sites (read-only backend access)
Supervisor: Internal user to manage shifts and incidents at assigned sites
Manager: Internal user to create and manage all operations at assigned sites
Administrator: Internal user with full system access to all sites
Site Assignment: Select sites below (leave empty for Administrators to see all sites)
Save the user - they will only see data from their assigned sites

p.em: Important: This is the ONLY place to manage site assignments for all users. Site assignments control what data users can access. Guards are portal users with mobile-only access. Use the "Create Guard User" wizard for simplified guard creation.

field.name: site_ids
field.placeholder: Select sites this user can access...
field.help: Sites assigned to this user. Leave empty for Administrators (they see all sites). Users only see records (shifts, incidents, checkpoints, tours, etc.) related to their assigned sites.
